headline: Unison: Expects Benefits From New Domestic Production Tax Credit; Strengthens Competitiveness of Domestic Wind Turbines
summary: Wind turbine maker Unison said its growth base could expand due to a domestic production tax credit in the government's 2026 tax reform plan. Certification changes are also expected to help competitiveness.
why: Unison is a South Korean wind turbine manufacturer, and government tax incentives for domestic wind equipment directly affect its margins and demand.
